questions.instructions: Find the minimum years of professional experience the posting REQUIRES for a candidate with the education in candidate_context. If the posting gives different floors per degree, use the one matching that education; for a range, use the lower bound. Preferred or nice-to-have experience does not count.

criteria.under_3: The required minimum for this candidate is under 3 years.
criteria.three_plus: The required minimum for this candidate is 3 years or more.
criteria.not_stated: The posting states no required years of experience.
criteria.unclear: Years are mentioned but the requirement for this candidate cannot be determined.
